body: A good leader does not stop with rebuke. Nehemiah took steps to correct problems—steps we should take first as leaders when we are wrong and steps we should require of those in our organization when they blow it.
If there’s ever a time to take God seriously, it’s when we make a promise to Him.

In the end, once the people came to terms with God’s Word, corrected their actions, and committed their decision to the Lord, they were able to praise Him (see 5:13). Shalom returned, along with the sound of construction and God’s special favor.
